feeds.title: Wholeheartedly Laura Blog
feeds.description: This is a Health, fitness and lifestyle blog. Come and see some of my healthy tasty recipes, my fitness exploits and shopping hauls! I help women lead a more wholehearted life as well as offering support for new online coaches setting up kick ass freedom based businesses.

feeds.title: Liz Almond Blog
feeds.description: Liz Almond is a Mindset Shifter, Health Coach & Business Mentor based in UK. Her mission is to empower business owners to be abundant and prosperous. Keep up to date with latest articles from this blog.

feeds.title: The Healthy Gourmet
feeds.description: I am a certified Integrative Nutrition Health Coach. I can help you take charge of your health and well-being, with a true holistic approach that will give you the tools to live a more happy, healthy and re-balanced life.

feeds.title: Shine & Grow Blog
feeds.description: My name is Sara Benveniste, mum of 3 kids, Mindset & Wellness coach, musician, and intuitive writer from London, UK. Empowering people to develop a healthy growth mindset using some colorful tools to help improve their energy, happiness, and quality of life.

feeds.title: Health Steps Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Amanda, founder of Health Steps. I'm a qualified health coach. I help people, like you, to get the best results from your personal health goals. I also work with businesses, delivering health coaching services within a business setting, whether it be individual or group health coaching sessions, health assessments, workshops, talks or wellbeing events.

feeds.title: Jen-The Health Coach Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jen. A qualified nutrition and fitness coach who has spent over 3 years helping my members get amazing weight loss and fitness results to improve their health and confidence. Get recipes, demonstrations, tips, and advice on your health, nutrition, exercise, mindset, and motivation to help you improve your overall health and fitness.

feeds.title: UK & International Health Coaching Association Blog
feeds.description: The UK & International Health Coaching Association (UKIHCA) is a non-profit professional body for Health Coaching in the UK and Internationally. Members of the UKIHCA are fully qualified and credentialed professionals who have satisfied our robust professional standards and work within a defined Scope of Practice.

feeds.title: Coach
feeds.description: Coach is the health and fitness magazine for men who want to do something to make themselves healthier, fitter, and happier. We help readers make sense of the confusing wellness scene by demystifying fads and trends with expert advice.

feeds.title: The Nourished Body Blog
feeds.description: The Nourished Body is authored by Hannah Carr, a Health Coach. Her focus is on how natural food can energise and help heal you. Also supporting the emotional, physical and spiritual well being and serving your purpose.

feeds.title: Claire Ashton Blog
feeds.description: Female Personal Trainer and Health Coach covering Watford and surrounding area and online health coach specialising in women's health, wellness and fitness.

feeds.title: TBalance Blog
feeds.description: Tori is a London based Holistic Health Coach and TBalance is a service that will help you find balance in all areas of your life. Follow us to keep up with articles from TBalance.

feeds.title: Sarah Shaw Wellbeing
feeds.description: Founded by Malvern-based Personal Trainer, Lifestyle & Nutrition Coach and Biochemical Scientist Sarah Shaw, Sarah Shaw Wellbeing boasts a foundation in science, using proven exercise methods and the latest nutritional research for her busy and active clients. Using her extensive experience, Sarah works holistically, using fitness, nutrition, sleep and mindfulness techniques to improve your longevity.

feeds.title: The Complete Health Coach Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my nutrition, training, and exercise blog page. This is your personal, informational vault. Read, learn, and grow your knowledge base. Helping people to improve their long-term health is what gets me out of bed in the morning. I find nothing more rewarding than one of my clients telling me that they are happy that they have lost weight, or that they feel fitter and stronger or more energetic.

feeds.title: Academy Healing Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: By drawing on Traditional Chinese Medicine, Taoist tonic herbalism, Ayurveda, Blue Zone diets, and modern nutritional breakthroughs, the Academy provides an in-depth and flexible approach focused on an individual's constitutional and health needs. Learn diet & lifestyle tips, healthy recipes, holistic health coaching, and more from cultures of longevity around the world, including Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and Ayurveda.

feeds.title: Farida Ibrahim Health Coach Blog
feeds.description: My name is Farida and I am a health coach based in London. My purpose and happiness in life are deeply rooted in investing in my health and well-being. I am fully equipped to work with clients to really break down the barriers that are stopping them from reaching their goals and motivate clients to take accountability of their health.

feeds.title: Sano Blog
feeds.description: Sano School of Culinary Medicine is the UK's leading online nutrition education school offering dedicated, comprehensive online nutrition courses. Our aim with Sano is to provide people with the skills to use food and nutrition for medicinal health benefits for their own health and to help others to do the same.

feeds.title: Blossom Health Coaching Blog
feeds.description: The Blossom Health Coaching blog is a valuable resource for women seeking information and guidance on a variety of health and wellness topics. The blog is written by Cathy Houghton, a qualified health coach and personal trainer, who shares her expertise in a clear and informative way. The blog covers a wide range of topics, including menopause, weight loss, distressed eating, movement coaching, and healthy recipes.

feeds.title: CNM Health Coach Blog
feeds.description: The CNM Health Coach Training has been developed to meet increasing demand from clients and health professionals who do not have the time and skills to administer and coach clients to achieve stable health results. Learn from a training provider with experience in training nutrition and wellness professionals.
